revisionDesc.change: Submit - Corrected this peculiar element in the xml: <:ἀρούραις|reg|ἀρού31.- ρες:>, which may be putting the line numbering out, to <:ἀρούραις|reg|ἀρούρες:>
Vote - AcceptText - Yes this looks like a sensible presentation of the traces and space involved.
Vote - AcceptText - Accept. Seems cautious, prudent. lin14==> <:[$m3] [.?]απ[.20-25] [εὐ]δ̣ο̣κ̣ῶ=PN N.Reggiani and U.Yiftach (digital image)|ed|[ $m3 Ἡρακλῆς πρεσβύτερος] Ἀπ[ολλωνίου εὐδοκ]ῶ:>.

Proposed correction in column i, l. 14: from the photo (http://brema.suub.uni-bremen.de/papyri/content/zoom/450558) it seems that the lacuna after απ is wider than suggested by the ed.pr., and therefore the original supplement is unlikely: in the parallel cases of loans with security the person who expresses the eudokesis clause is the borrower (Demetria Epimachou in this case) and not the lender (Herakles Apolloniou here): cf. P.Dura 23, P.Flor I 1, SB I 4370. If so, then απ could belong to any word, not necessarily to a proper name. Moreover, there seem to be some visible traces of letters before the final omega.
